keyClaims: UU 11/1969 Pasal 11: 2.5% per year, max 75%, floor against lowest applicable basic salary

UU 11/1969 Pasal 6(5) rounds a fractional month upward
Calculator is illustrative and does not determine eligibility or official payment

findings: Target article omitted the shared assets/site.css and favicon references.
Target article omitted the sticky site header and primary navigation.
The hero figure used 20px padding and lacked responsive image sizing, clipping the 16:9 artwork.
Article-specific CSS diverged from the shared frozen article layout and omitted source styles for typography, tables, and responsive related content.
Target footer and author block lacked some standard links and spacing.
The table of contents listed the calculator before the formula although the page body showed formula first.
The article repeated the heading 'Inti ketentuan' in the quick summary and main body.
fixes: Loaded shared site CSS and favicon links; added standard header/navigation.
Applied the reference article's full layout stylesheet, preserving only calculator-specific styles.
Restored responsive hero image rule and removed padded clipping frame.
Aligned article metadata, quick facts, TOC order, author block, related block, feedback copy, share copy, and footer with the reference template.
Renamed the repeated body heading and made page skip navigation target the main article.
